jobs.description:

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities


In this role, you will have the opportunity to set up and execute tests for different products in accordance with standard testing methodologies and requirements.

Each day, you will perform your tasks or activities using skills and techniques as well as a practical understanding of concepts used in the field of technology.

You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring proper documentation of the test results.

The work model for the role is: onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Buildings, Energy Distribution business in Schaffhausen.

  • Identifying and suggesting solutions related to product non-conformities.
  • Assisting external certification inspectors during testing activities for ABB or external customer products

• Qualifications for the role

  • You hold a bachelor’s degree or Techniker HF in electronical or electrical engineering.
  • You have knowledge of instrumentation and electrical systems.
  • You are qualified in executing buildup of set up and system of testing
  • You have a collaborative, solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills.
  • Fluent German skills (spoken and written); English skills are an advantage

jobs.title: Experimental Physicist 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Device Physics

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.


The work model for the role is hybrid.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conducting applied research in the area of electrical power-device physics with a primary focus on Applied Thermodynamics and Thermal management; and contribute to related Multi-physics domains such as Electromagnetics and Fluid Dynamics
  • Contributing to and lead research projects supporting the ongoing energy transformation through innovative electrical power technologies and multi-physics solutions
  • Planning, setting up, and executing scientific experiments
  • Driving research activities, generating intellectual property, and writing scientific publications
  • Closely working with scientists and engineers within the team, driving collaborations within the research center, with universities, and global ABB divisions.


 • Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in Physics or Mechanical Engineering
  • Background in the areas of Heat and Mass transfer, and Applied Thermodynamics. Knowledge of electromagnetism is a plus (please submit a list of publications if available).
  • Previous experience in Project Management is essential for this role
  • Hands-on experience in a scientific or industrial laboratory, a willingness to work independently and take initiatives in designing, building, and testing prototypes
  • Experience in multi-physics simulations, e.g., COMSOL, CFD
  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach with good ability to build and maintain work relationships
  • Strong communication and presentation skills in English (both written and spoken)


More about us
The Power Device Physics Team at the ABB research center in Switzerland conducts interdisciplinary research focusing on multi-physical phenomena related to the broad portfolio of ABB's devices and systems, including switchgear and power electronics. The team consists of enthusiastic scientists and engineers whose activities span from deepening the knowledge of physical phenomena such as dielectric breakdowns in gases/solids/vacuum, or thermal management with novel cooling concepts, to solving questions directly related to ABB's product portfolio. Our expertise and solutions are used to enable and support the development of next-generation products. This unique opportunity allows you to carry out research in an evolving field and to contribute with your expertise to ABB’s success by reinforcing our team. If you are passionate about science and technology and want to work in an inspiring environment where your skills and ideas become part of solutions for a sustainable future, then apply now.


This recruitment process is actively managed by Pedro Labian, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Collaborare a stretto contatto con scienziati e ingegneri all'interno del team, promuovendo collaborazioni all'interno del centro di ricerca, con università e con le divisioni globali di ABB.

  • Dottorato di ricerca in Fisica o Ingegneria meccanica
  • Formazione negli ambiti del trasferimento di calore e di massa e della termodinamica applicata. La conoscenza dell'elettromagnetismo costituisce un valore aggiunto (si prega di inviare un elenco delle pubblicazioni, se disponibile).
  • La precedente esperienza nella gestione dei progetti è essenziale per questo ruolo
  • Esperienza pratica in un laboratorio scientifico o industriale, disponibilità a lavorare in autonomia e a prendere iniziative nella progettazione, costruzione e collaudo di prototipi
  • Esperienza in simulazioni multifisiche, ad es. COMSOL, CFD
  • Un approccio collaborativo e orientato alle soluzioni, con una buona capacità di instaurare e mantenere rapporti di lavoro
  • Spiccate capacità comunicative e di presentazione in inglese (scritto e parlato)


Maggiori informazioni su di noi
Il team di fisica dei dispositivi di potenza presso il centro di ricerca di ABB in Svizzera conduce attività di ricerca interdisciplinare incentrate sui fenomeni multifisici relativi all'ampio portafoglio di dispositivi e sistemi di ABB, tra cui apparecchiature di manovra ed elettronica di potenza. Il team è composto da scienziati e ingegneri entusiasti, le cui attività spaziano dall'approfondimento della conoscenza di fenomeni fisici quali la rottura dielettrica in gas/solidi/vuoto o la gestione termica con innovativi concetti di raffreddamento, alla risoluzione di questioni direttamente correlate al portafoglio di prodotti di ABB. Le nostre competenze e soluzioni vengono utilizzate per rendere possibile e supportare lo sviluppo di prodotti di nuova generazione. Questa opportunità unica consente di svolgere attività di ricerca in un settore in evoluzione e di contribuire con le tue competenze al successo di ABB, rafforzando il nostro team. Se ti appassionano la scienza e la tecnologia e desideri lavorare in un ambiente stimolante, in cui le tue competenze e idee diventano parte di soluzioni per un futuro sostenibile, candidati ora.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist hybrid.


Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

 • Qualifications pour le poste

  • De solides compétences en communication et en présentation en anglais (à l’écrit comme à l’oral)

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Process Industries division in Switzerland.

In this role you will work alongside the Solid-State Transformer and System Architecture teams to design and develop a DC-DC power converter coupling energy storage system to 800 V DC bus.


In this role, you will lead Power Electronics System Design including electro-thermo-mechanical inte-gration, main system, sub-systems and components specification, testing, qualification and certifica-tion for the new ABB DC-DC converters of the ABB DC Architecture offering of the new ABB Infinitus Direct Current (DC) Portfolio for Datacenters.


You will be part of advanced R&D activities in the field of power electronics for the ABB SST for Datacenter Products, in close cooperation with a highly qualified senior team of R&D engineers and scientists in a global and multicultural setup.

The work model for the role is: #LI-On Site

Baden-Daettwil, Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • You will be leading the Power Electronics System Design, specification, testing and qualifica-tion of the main sub-systems of the DC-DC power converter in normal and special operating conditions. The tasks cover the phases from the conceptual system design integration of the Power Electronics DC-DC Converter System using analytical and simulation tools to their final validation in the R&D labs. In addition, there will be a special focus on the qualification and productization of the DC-DC System Design in close collaboration with the rest of R&D design functions as Control Hardware and Software, Mechanical, Verification and Validation
  • R&D technical close collaboration and interaction with the different stakeholders in the organi-zation for DC Data Center incubator: program manager, product architect, research scientist, productization team, DC distribution program team etc.
  • Contribution to the maintenance and further development of the key Power Electronics Tech-nologies Expertise and Know-How of the SST and DC-DC for Datacenters R&D team, including IP and Standards activities.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • University Master’s degree, PhD in the field of electrical engineering with a focus on Power Electronics and orientation to High Power and Medium Voltage applications.
  • Solid background experience (> 5 years) in Power Electronics system design and development or equivalent related experience. Expertise and practical experience on High Power and Medium Voltage converters is an advantage.
  • Experience in leading and organizing technical backlogs for R&D teams.
  • Experience in modelling, simulation and power electronics system analysis and design analysis using state-of-the-art simulation and engineering design tools.

Production Supervisor

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will support the implementation of the local quality strategy, driving a strong quality culture, continuous improvement, and sustainable problem-solving. As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will ensure that all purchased materials and services meet ABB standards by qualifying suppliers, monitoring performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve world-class results.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Buildings / Supplier Business Excellence & Development in Schaffhausen.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Supplier Qualification & Audits: Qualify and approve new suppliers and conduct regular process, system, and product audits.
  • Quality • Requirements & FAI: Define and communicate quality requirements and lead First Article Inspections and qualification processes.
  • Performance Monitoring & Improvement: Track supplier performance using KPIs (e.g., PPM, OTD) and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Non-Conformance Management: Investigate quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and ensure effective corrective actions (8D/CAPA).


• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field) or equivalent professional experience
  • Good knowledge of English and German (spoken and written); additional languages are a plus
  • Experience in supplier quality management and supplier audits (ISO 9001, VDA 6.3, IATF 16949 or similar)
  • Knowledge of APQP/PPAP and First Article Inspection (FAI)
  • Strong problem-solving skills using root cause analysis methods (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa)
  • Understanding of statistical quality methods (SPC, MSA, Gauge R&R)
  • Knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and material/component specifications


Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance


More about us
ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment process is led by talent partner, Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Trade ＆ Transportation Manager AU

__

Your role and responsibilities
As a Senior Trade & Transportation Specialist, you will play a key role in shaping logistics solutions for complex international projects. Beyond transport execution, you will act as a trusted advisor to Sales, Project Management, Engineering and Supply Chain teams, helping to identify logistics risks early and develop practical, cost-effective transportation concepts.

In this role, you will combine operational project logistics expertise with strategic thinking to support tendering activities, optimize logistics costs and strengthen ABB's competitiveness in global project business. Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, you will help ensure successful project execution while continuously improving logistics processes and capabilities.

While your primary focus will be on international project logistics, you will also contribute to the overall success of the Transport & Trade team by supporting operational and service-related logistics activities whenever business needs require it. We are looking for a collaborative, hands-on team player who enjoys working across different logistics environments and helping colleagues achieve common goals.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

Reporting to the Team Lead Transport & Trade, you will support ABB's global business activities from Switzerland and contribute to the successful delivery of projects worldwide.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Act as the logistics lead for complex international project shipments, including heavy lift, oversized and special transport requirements.
  • Support tendering and project execution by assessing logistics risks, developing transportation concepts and advising key stakeholders.
  • Manage logistics service provider selection, RFQs and transportation execution while ensuring cost-effective, reliable and compliant solutions.
  • Actively contribute to the success of the wider Transport & Trade team by supporting both project and operational logistics activities, driving collaboration and continuous improvement, and demonstrating flexibility and a collaborative, hands-on approach whenever business priorities require it.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed vocational or higher education in Freight Forwarding, International Transportation, Logistics, Foreign Trade, or a related field
  • Several years of experience in international transportation and project logistics, ideally in heavy lift, oversized cargo, or industrial project environments, with a proven track record of managing complex global logistics projects
  • Strong knowledge of freight forwarding, carrier management, logistics procurement, transportation risk assessment, customs procedures, Incoterms, export controls, and international trade regulations
  • Commercial mindset with the ability to evaluate logistics solutions from a business and total cost perspective
  • Collaborative, hands-on team player with excellent communication and influencing skills, able to translate complex logistics topics for diverse audiences
  • Fluent in English and German; additional language skills are a plus
  • Experience with SAP/GTS is advantageous

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance
  • Eco bonus

More about us
The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminium smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

The recruitment process is led by Ece Özen, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Approfondita conoscenza di spedizioni di merci, gestione dei vettori, approvvigionamento logistico, valutazione dei rischi di trasporto, procedure doganali, Incoterms, controlli sulle esportazioni e normative sul commercio internazionale
  • Mentalità commerciale con la capacità di valutare soluzioni logistiche dal punto di vista aziendale e dei costi totali
  • Giocatore di squadra collaborativo e pratico con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e influenza, in grado di tradurre argomenti logistici complessi per pubblici diversi
  • Fluente in inglese e tedesco; ulteriori competenze linguistiche sono un vantaggio
  • Un'esperienza con SAP/GTS è vantaggiosa

Offriamo inoltre ai nostri dipendenti i seguenti vantaggi:

  • Credito REKA
  • Sconti per i dipendenti (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental ferie
  • Indennità di idoneità
  • Eco bonus

Maggiori informazioni su di noi
La divisione Process Industries serve i settori minerario, lavorazione dei minerali, metalli, cemento, pasta di legno e carta, produzione di batterie e alimenti e bevande, nonché le industrie di servizi associate. La Divisione apporta una profonda esperienza nel settore industriale unita alla capacità di integrare sia l'automazione che i sistemi elettrici, aumentare la produttività e ridurre i costi complessivi di capitale e operativi per i clienti. Per i clienti del settore minerario, dei metalli e del cemento, le soluzioni includono prodotti e servizi specializzati, nonché sistemi di produzione completi. La Divisione progetta, pianifica, ingegnerizza, fornisce, installa e mette in servizio sistemi elettrici e di movimento integrati, comprese apparecchiature elettriche, azionamenti, motori, raddrizzatori ad alta potenza e apparecchiature per l'automazione e il controllo di supervisione in una varietà di aree tra cui la movimentazione dei minerali, le operazioni minerarie, la fusione dell'alluminio, le applicazioni dell'acciaio a caldo e freddo e la produzione di cemento. L'offerta per le industrie della pasta e della carta comprende sistemi di controllo, sistemi di controllo qualità, sistemi di azionamento, sensori in linea, attuatori e strumenti sul campo. Le soluzioni di digitalizzazione, comprese le operazioni collaborative e la realtà aumentata, aiutano a migliorare la produttività degli stabilimenti e delle imprese e a ridurre i costi di manutenzione ed energia.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle lautet: hybrid

  • Handeln Sie als Logistikleiter für komplexe internationale Projektsendungen, einschließlich Schwergut, übergroße und spezielle Transportanforderungen.

  • Tragen Sie aktiv zum Erfolg des breiteren Transport & Trade-Teams bei, indem Sie sowohl die Projekt- als auch die operativen Logistikaktivitäten unterstützen, die Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierliche Verbesserung vorantreiben und Flexibilität und einen kollaborativen, praxisorientierten Ansatz demonstrieren, wenn es die Geschäftsprioritäten erfordern.

  • Abgeschlossene berufliche oder Hochschulbildung in Spedition, internationalem Transport, Logistik, Außenhandel oder einem verwandten Bereich
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der internationalen Transport- und Projektlogistik, idealerweise in Schwerlast-, Großfracht- oder industriellen Projektumgebungen, mit nachgewiesener Erfolgsbilanz im Management komplexer globaler Logistikprojekte
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Spedition, Carrier Management, Logistikbeschaffung, Risikobewertung von Transporten, Zollverfahren, Incoterms, Exportkontrollen und internationale Handelsregeln
  • Kommerzielle Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, Logistiklösungen aus der Geschäfts- und Gesamtkostenperspektive zu bewerten
  • Kollaborativer, praktischer Teamplayer mit hervorragenden Kommunikations- und Einflussfähigkeiten, der in der Lage ist, komplexe Logistikthemen für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen zu übersetzen
  • Fluent in Englisch und Deutsch; zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus
  • Erfahrung mit SAP/GTS ist vorteilhaft

Benefits

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Team Leader

__

As a Mechanical Site Supervisor, you will represent ABB at customer sites in the mining industry. You will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and supervising all mechanical work related to the installation and maintenance of ABB Gearless Mill Drives (GMD). This includes leading on-site teams, ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards, and acting as the key technical liaison between ABB and the customer.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Process Industries division in Switzerland.

• Your responsibilities

  • Supervise mechanical maintenance and installation activities for GMD at customer sites. Coordinate mechanical work based on project scope, site conditions, and available resources.

  • Enforce ABB’s EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) policies and conduct safety briefings before work begins and guide and support local mechanics, welders, and helpers in executing tasks safely and efficiently.

  • Ensure all work is performed according to the latest technical documentation and ABB quality standards. Additionally, identify and report technical discrepancies in drawings or documentation.

  • Participate in site meetings with customers, contractors, and ABB teams as well as prepare clear and accurate service and installation reports.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an industrial or mechanical technician/engineer.

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in mechanical site work, preferably in mining, heavy industry or power plants.

  • Strong technical understanding of mechanical systems; knowledge of ABB GMD systems is an advantage.

  • Fluent in English; Spanish is a plus.

  • Willingness to travel globally on short notice, including weekends and public holidays.

  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and instructions in English.

  • Strong teamwork, leadership, and communication skills.

More about us
Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry-specific products, and lifecycle services across industries. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment; digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality to help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Sie werden an fortschrittlichen F&E- und Produktisierungsaktivitäten im Bereich der Leistungselektronik für die ABB-SST-Produkte für Rechenzentren mitwirken, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem hochqualifizierten, erfahrenen Team aus F&E-Ingenieurinnen und -Ingenieuren sowie Beteiligten in einem globalen und multikulturellen Umfeld.

  • Als Mitglied des F&E-Teams für SST-Produkte für Rechenzentren leiten Sie die Konformitäts- und Zertifizierungsaktivitäten für die SST-Produktentwicklung – von der Auslegung über die Validierung bis hin zu den abschließenden Zertifizierungsphasen der Produktentwicklung – gemäß den einschlägigen Anwendungsnormen und -richtlinien, z. B. UL, IEC, REACH, RoHS usw.   • Sie sind für die Verwaltung und Pflege der Dokumentation zur SST-Produktkonformität und -zertifizierung verantwortlich, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Produktisierungs- und Betriebsteams während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.

  • Abschluss im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik usw.) mit Erfahrung im Bereich Compliance und Zertifizierung von Leistungselektronikprodukten. Erfahrung mit MV-Leistungselektronikprodukten ist von Vorteil.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse und Expertise in Compliance- und Zertifizierungsaktivitäten wie der Analyse und Interpretation von Normen, der Festlegung von Prüfplänen und Spezifikationen, der Durchführung von Prüfungen, der Zusammenarbeit mit Zertifizierungsstellen, der Verwaltung von Zertifizierungsdokumentation usw.
  • Ausgeprägtes Interesse und Fokus auf die praktische Verifizierung und Validierung in einer MV-Laborumgebung im Hinblick auf Compliance und Zertifizierung neuer Produkte sowie die Einführung neuer Funktionen auf dem Markt. Expertise in Compliance-Bereichen wie elektrische Sicherheit, funktionale Sicherheit usw. ist von Vorteil.
  • Interesse an angewandter Forschung und Produktentwicklung, eine eigenständig arbeitende, motivierte Person, die gerne in einem hochqualifizierten Forschungs- und Entwicklungsteam arbeitet, das sich aus Experten verschiedener Fachgebiete an globalen Standorten zusammensetzt.
  • Fließende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen.
